abstract: Covers the AGENTS.md open format published at agents.md and stewarded by the Agentic AI Foundation under the Linux Foundation: what the file is, root and nested placement, precedence (closest file wins, user prompts override), what to put in it, how it complements README.md, and migrating from tool-specific instruction files as each tool's own documentation describes. The format is unversioned, so its single line, site-2026-03-10 (current), is pinned to commit 342016eb22df of the agentsmd/agents.md site source. SKILL.md holds the invariants and workflow; references split out versions, format and placement, the writing and review guide, and migration.
